pins.definition: Recently made, built, or created, and not used before.
Recently made, built, or acquired; not old or used before.
Recently made, built, bought, or created; not used or old.

situation: A young man carefully peels the stiff, crinkling protective film off the pristine glass screen of a brand-new smartphone he just took out of its box.
subject: the brand-new smartphone
brief: A man holds a smartphone in the center of the frame, its screen gleaming and unmarred by even a single fingerprint. He is carefully peeling back a thick, translucent protective sticker that curls away from the glass, revealing the deep, flawless black surface underneath. The phone is the focal point, brightly lit, while the surrounding table is soft and blurred to emphasize the object's untouched, manufactured perfection.
prompt: A man holds a smartphone in the center of the frame, its screen gleaming and unmarred by even a single fingerprint. The phone is the focal point, brightly lit, while the surrounding table is soft and blurred to emphasize the object's untouched, manufactured perfection. loose watercolour washes over confident ink linework, blooms and granulation in the pigment, warm paper grain, the warmth of a picture book for adults. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
